approvedBy: Nell: '2,3, then 1 please.' (2026-11-05), option 3: test the severity line on the cloud models
question: Does the D-028 severity line help Claude Haiku 5.5, MillOS's default cloud model, on the same strategy cases, without hurting anything else?

design.prompts: the exact strategicPrompt texts of the local test's 14 cases (10 healthy-base cases plus the 4 extra two-anomaly pairs), dumped once from the app with and without the line by browser_eval.mjs --prompts-only
design.request: the app's own Haiku request (cloudAIClient.ts): claude-haiku-5-5, max_tokens 4096, thinking adaptive, effort high, the prompt as one user message
design.repeats: 5 per arm, 70 calls per arm, arms interleaved call by call
design.parse: the same {...}-extracting parser as the eval and aiEngine

rule.adoptIf: the same five conditions as prereg-severity-line.json (two-anomaly gain >= 5 of 30; other cases lose <= 1 of 40; parsed lose <= 1 of 70; median seconds <= 1.2x; formulaic share <= +0.05)
rule.note: if base already scores >= 26/30 on two-anomaly cases, a gain of 5 is impossible and the line is not needed on Haiku
rule.ifPass: add the line for the Haiku backends (haiku, openrouter-haiku); other cloud models stay without it until measured
rule.otherwise: no change: the line stays local-only
